title: Complete WLR v0 seed with MyCrypto
notes: First-party MyCrypto, Consensys, and official GitHub sources only. Acquisition is not treated as shutdown; current endpoint availability is distinguished from maintenance/support status.

entities.summary: Open-source self-custody Ethereum account-management and wallet interface launched as the MyCrypto brand in 2018 and acquired by Consensys in 2022 to work alongside MetaMask.
entities.notes: MyCrypto emerged from a 2018 split with MyEtherWallet but is modeled as a distinct entity, not as a MyEtherWallet alias. Consensys acquired MyCrypto in 2022. The current web and download endpoints remain reachable, so acquisition is not equated with product shutdown.

products.summary: Browser-based MyCrypto Ethereum account-management interface, currently reachable at app.mycrypto.com.
products.notes: Current endpoint availability is verified; no current first-party maintenance commitment is inferred from availability alone.

products.summary: Electron-based MyCrypto desktop application introduced to handle private keys, mnemonics, and keystore files outside the browser environment.
products.notes: The official download endpoint remains reachable, but the latest formal GitHub release is old; WLR therefore records limited status and unknown support rather than claiming active maintenance or discontinuation.

events.title: MyCrypto brand launched
events.description: MyCrypto launched as a new Ethereum wallet-interface brand following the split between Taylor Monahan and the MyEtherWallet project.
events.notes: The February 10 launch FAQ describes the brand launch as having occurred within the preceding day; WLR retains month-level precision rather than inventing an exact launch timestamp.

events.title: MyCrypto Desktop officially launched
events.description: MyCrypto released its stable desktop applications and moved raw private-key, mnemonic, and keystore-file access out of the web interface into the desktop application.

events.title: Consensys acquired MyCrypto
events.description: Consensys announced the acquisition of MyCrypto to combine its work with MetaMask while MyCrypto stated that its existing products would continue operating in the short term.
events.notes: The acquisition announcement described gradual product convergence rather than an immediate MyCrypto shutdown.

evidence.title: MyCrypto Launch FAQ

evidence.title: Consensys Acquires MyCrypto to Strengthen MetaMask Partnership and Enhance Web3 Experiences

evidence.title: MyCrypto is Joining MetaMask to Lead The Way to Web3
evidence.notes: Primary MyCrypto-side acquisition announcement stating products would not immediately go away and longer-term convergence would be gradual.

evidence.title: MyCrypto Web App
evidence.notes: Current MyCrypto web application endpoint remains reachable.

evidence.notes: Official public repository remains non-archived; repository metadata identifies MyCrypto as an open-source Ethereum account-management tool.
